an7.15:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattime bhikkhave udakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an7.15:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggova hoti.
an7.15:1.4: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā nimujjati.
an7.15:1.5: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti.
an7.15:1.6: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā vipassati, viloketi.
an7.15:1.7: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā patarati.
an7.15:1.8: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā patigādhappatto hoti.
an7.15:1.9: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo. (1)
an7.15:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggova hoti:
an7.15:2.2: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo samannāgato hoti ekanta kāḷakehi akusalehi dhammehi.
an7.15:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggova hoti. (2)
an7.15:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati “sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri …pe…
an7.15:3.6: tassa sā saddhā neva tiṭṭhati, no vaḍḍhati, hāyateva. tassa sā hiri …pe…
an7.15:3.9: tassa sā paññā neva tiṭṭhati, no vaḍḍhati, hāyateva.
an7.15:3.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā nimujjati. (3)
an7.15:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti:
an7.15:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati “sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri …pe…
an7.15:4.6: tassa sā saddhā neva hāyati, no vaḍḍhati, ṭhitā hoti.
an7.15:4.10: tassa sā paññā neva hāyati, no vaḍḍhati, ṭhitā hoti.
an7.15:4.11: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti. (4)
an7.15:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā vipassati, viloketi:
an7.15:5.2: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati “sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri …pe…
an7.15:5.6: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
an7.15:5.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā vipassati. viloketi. (5)
an7.15:6.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati “sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri …pe…
an7.15:6.6: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti. sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
an7.15:6.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā patarati. (6)
an7.15:7.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā patigādhappatto hoti:
an7.15:7.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati “sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri …pe…
an7.15:7.6: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an7.15:7.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā patigādhappatto hoti. (7)
an7.15:8.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo:
an7.15:8.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati “sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri …pe…
an7.15:8.6: so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto vimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.15:8.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
an7.15:9.1: ime kho bhikkhave satta udakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
